description: Two `<engine for=Phase>` declarations both auto-declare `@phase`. Per §51.0.C the duplicate auto-declared variable is rejected with E-ENGINE-VAR-DUPLICATE (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.0.C — the first `<engine for=T>` in a scope AUTO-DECLARES the cell `@t` (lowercase-leading-run of the type name). A second engine over the same type would auto-declare the same name, and since §51.0.A makes an engine a singleton keyed by that variable, the two declarations would silently contend for one cell. `var=` exists precisely to disambiguate, so the collision is rejected rather than resolved by declaration order.
